attribute_fields.COMMENTS: Connecticut military retirement income exclusion. Provides 100% exclusion for military retirement pay, SBP payments, and National Guard/Reserve pay. Honors MSRRA (spouse income exempt if different domicile) and SCRA (active duty pay exempt if different state of residence). Per CT Gen. Stat. § 12-701 (2025).
Connecticut state income tax calculation. Implements progressive tax structure with 7 brackets per CT Department of Revenue Services (2025).
